name: ai-game-studio-unreal
description: An opt-in, pinned Unreal Engine MCP adapter and safety workflow for Codex AI Game Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and operate one pinned Unreal MCP safely.
interface.longDescription: Detects Unreal projects, plans the IvanMurzak Unreal MCP adapter, checks conflicts and permissions, and requires confirmation before setup or editor writes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-unreal:setup-unreal to inspect this Unreal project and propose a pinned setup. Do not change anything yet.
